[.verse-line]
[.i266]##{nbsp}##Death is a Fisherman, the world we see
[.i265]##{nbsp}##His Fish-pond is, and we the Fishes be:
[.i265]##{nbsp}##His Net some general Sickness; howe’er he
[.i261]##{nbsp}##Is not so kind as other Fishers be;
[.i265]##{nbsp}##For if they take one of the smaller Fry,
[.i248]##{nbsp}##They throw him in again, he shall not die:
[.i263]##{nbsp}##But Death is sure to kill all he can get,
[.i270]##{nbsp}##And all is Fish with him that comes to Net.
